events.title: Royal Treasury Find
events.description: Your steward unearths a forgotten chest of the old kings.

events.title: Crown Tax
events.description: The royal tax collectors levy 10 G on every territory you own.

events.title: Royal Escort
events.description: A knightly escort speeds you 4 tiles along the King's Road.

events.title: Siege Delay
events.description: A flooded road forces you back 2 tiles.

events.title: Herald's Favor
events.description: The Herald grants you a Reroll Token.

events.title: Coronation Feast
events.description: Every rival offers 30 G tribute at the feast.

events.title: Grand Tourney
events.description: Your champions win the joust: 10 G for every territory you own.

events.title: Royal Pardon
events.description: The crown restores 1 Life.

events.title: Court Wizard's Gift
events.description: The court wizard hands you a special die.

events.title: Golden Harvest Fair
events.description: The trade guilds boom: every portfolio rises 20%.

events.title: War Rumors
events.description: Rumors of war spook the guilds: every portfolio falls 10%.

events.title: Royal Gambling Hall
events.description: A noble slips you a free casino chip; you play it at once.

dice.name: Charger Die
dice.desc: Your next move is boosted by the face value.

dice.name: Decree Die
dice.desc: Issue a royal decree: every rival pays you the face. The last face is a failed decree and costs you.

dice.name: Rogue Die
dice.desc: Steal gold from the richest rival. The last face gets you caught: you pay a fine.

dice.name: Tribute Die
dice.desc: Your vassals pay tribute: gold equal to the face for every territory you own.

dice.name: Guild Broker Die
dice.desc: Moves your stock portfolio by the face (%). With no stocks you first get a free 100 G stake.

dice.name: Physician Die
dice.desc: The royal physician restores Life equal to the face (nothing at full Life).

events.title: Mana Cache
events.description: You uncover a cache of crystallized mana.

events.title: Arcane Tithe
events.description: The Conclave demands 100 G in tithe.

events.title: Ley Line Surge
events.description: A ley line whisks you to a random portal.

events.title: Wild Teleport
events.description: A wild spell drops you on a random territory.

events.title: Astral Boon
events.description: The stars grant you 2 Reroll Tokens.

events.title: Equinox Gathering
events.description: Every rival offers 25 G to the circle.

events.title: Spell Misfire
events.description: Your spell backfires: you skip your next turn.

events.title: Temporal Spell
events.description: A haste spell grants you an extra roll.

events.title: Enchanted Die
events.description: You enchant a special die.

events.title: Mana Boom
events.description: Mana prices soar: every portfolio rises 30%.

events.title: Spell Fizzle
events.description: Enchantments fail: every portfolio falls 30%.

events.title: Fortune Rune
events.description: A fortune rune grants you a free casino chip.

dice.name: Ritual Die
dice.desc: Channel a ritual: gain Reroll Tokens equal to the face (it can fizzle on 0).

dice.name: Portal Spell Die
dice.desc: Teleport instead of rolling: mostly to a portal.

dice.name: Mana Broker Die
dice.desc: Moves your stock portfolio by the face (%): wild swings. With no stocks you first get a free 100 G stake.

dice.name: Binding Die
dice.desc: Bends the turn order: a rival may be bound (skips a turn).

dice.name: Oracle Die
dice.desc: Consult the oracle: 1-2 lose gold, 3 go back 3 tiles, 4-6 win gold (6 also a Reroll Token).

dice.name: Arcane Surge Die
dice.desc: A surge of raw mana: gain or lose gold equal to the face.

events.title: Scrap Jackpot
events.description: You salvage rare parts worth good gold.

events.title: Factory Inspection
events.description: Inspectors fine every territory you own 15 G.

events.title: Steam Boost
events.description: A steam catapult launches you 5 tiles ahead.

events.title: Boiler Backfire
events.description: A pressure surge throws you back 3 tiles.

events.title: Spare Gear
events.description: You find a spare Reroll Token.

events.title: Factory Output
events.description: Your factories run flat out: 15 G for every territory you own.

events.title: Gear Jam
events.description: A gear jams: you skip your next turn.

events.title: Overclock
events.description: Your engine overclocks: an extra roll.

events.title: Prototype Die
events.description: Engineers hand you a prototype die.

events.title: Industrial Boom
events.description: Production soars: every portfolio rises 25%.

events.title: Factory Strike
events.description: Strikes hit the markets: every portfolio falls 15%.

events.title: Patent Sale
events.description: You sell a patent by undercutting the richest rival: take 50 G from them.

dice.name: Overclock Die
dice.desc: Overclock the turn: extra roll, a token, gold, or a jam that stalls the next rival.

dice.name: Piston Die
dice.desc: Your next move is boosted by the face value (the last face is a backfire).

dice.name: Factory Die
dice.desc: Your factories pay out: gold equal to the face for every territory you own.

dice.name: Ticker Die
dice.desc: Ticker tape luck: gain or lose gold equal to the face.

dice.name: Saboteur Die
dice.desc: Steal gold from the richest rival. The last face gets you caught: you pay a fine.

dice.name: Spare Parts Die
dice.desc: Scavenge parts: gain Reroll Tokens equal to the face.

events.title: Ancient Seed Hoard
events.description: You find a hoard of rare seeds worth gold.

events.title: Locust Swarm

events.title: Pollen Breeze
events.description: A warm breeze carries you 2 tiles ahead.

events.title: Thorn Thicket
events.description: Thick thorns trap you: you skip your next turn.

events.title: Spirit Blessing
events.description: A forest spirit grants you a Reroll Token.

events.title: Harvest Feast
events.description: Every rival brings 15 G to the feast.

events.title: Growth Spurt
events.description: Nature quickens: an extra roll.

events.title: Druid's Gift
events.description: A druid gives you a special die.

events.title: Bloom Season
events.description: Everything flowers: every portfolio rises 15%.

events.title: Blight
events.description: A blight strikes the markets: every portfolio falls 10%.

events.title: Spring of Life
events.description: Healing waters restore 2 Life.

events.title: Bumper Harvest
events.description: Your lands overflow: 12 G for every territory you own.

dice.name: Harvest Die
dice.desc: Reap your lands: gain gold equal to the face for every territory you own.

dice.name: Healing Spring Die
dice.desc: The spring restores Life equal to the face (nothing at full Life).

dice.name: Vine Die
dice.desc: Your next move is boosted by the face value.

dice.desc: Slow, steady growth of your portfolio by the face (%). With no stocks you first get a free 100 G stake.

dice.name: Foraging Die
dice.desc: Forage the forest: gain gold equal to the face.

dice.name: Spirit Die
dice.desc: A forest spirit gives you Reroll Tokens equal to the face.

events.title: Dragon's Hoard

events.title: Demon's Toll
events.description: A demon claims its toll: pay 150 G.

events.title: Battle Charge
events.description: A charge sweeps you 6 tiles forward.

events.title: Ashfall
events.description: Volcanic ash drives you back 4 tiles.

events.title: War Banner
events.description: A war banner earns you 2 Reroll Tokens.

events.title: Victory Revel
events.description: Every rival honors the victor with 50 G.

events.title: Bloodlust
events.description: Bloodlust grants you an extra roll.

events.title: Forged Die
events.description: The Hellforge yields a special die.

events.title: Pillage
events.description: You pillage the richest rival: take 80 G from them.

events.title: War Economy
events.description: War fuels the markets: every portfolio rises 30%.

events.title: Armistice
events.description: Peace breaks out: every portfolio falls 25%.

events.title: Pit Fight Bet
events.description: A pit-fight bookie hands you a free casino chip.

dice.name: Charge Die

dice.name: Pillager Die
dice.desc: Steal gold from the richest rival. The last face gets you caught: you pay a heavy fine.

events.title: Sea Charm

events.title: Port Festival
events.description: Every rival pays 20 G port tribute.

events.title: Pirate Raid
events.description: Pirates plunder your ship: pay 120 G.

events.title: Becalmed
events.description: The wind dies: you skip your next turn.

events.title: Pearl Die
events.description: A diver brings you a special die.

events.title: Trade Winds Boom
events.description: Shipping booms: every portfolio rises 25%.

events.title: Kraken Scare

dice.name: Tempest Die
dice.desc: A wild sea wind: your next move is changed by the face. It can blow you off course.

dice.name: Whirlpool Die
dice.desc: Teleport instead of rolling: mostly to a territory.

dice.name: Corsair Die
dice.desc: Steal gold from the richest rival. The last face gets you caught: you pay a fine.

dice.name: Merchant Die

dice.name: Treasure Dive Die

dice.desc: A sea charm gives you Reroll Tokens equal to the face.

events.title: Temporal Fold
events.description: Time folds: an extra roll.

events.title: Cosmic Die
events.description: A cosmic die falls from the sky.

events.title: Future Boom
events.description: Future prices leak: every portfolio rises 20%.

events.title: Timeline Collapse
events.description: The markets collapse: every portfolio falls 20%.

events.title: Probability Chip
events.description: A probability chip lands in your hand: a free casino play.

dice.name: Paradox Die
dice.desc: Warp through a paradox: START (twice as likely), a portal, or a territory.

dice.name: Epoch Die
dice.desc: Bends time itself: usually an extra roll.

dice.name: Fate Weave Die
dice.desc: Weave fate: 1-2 lose gold, 3 go back 3 tiles, 4-6 win gold (6 also a Reroll Token).

dice.name: Futures Die
